content.title: React 19 adds Actions, new hooks and form APIs, and removes long-deprecated APIs you must migrate away from.

keyPoints.text: `startTransition` now accepts async functions, so Transitions can include side effects like `fetch()`.
keyPoints.quote: Actions: `startTransition` can now accept async functions.

keyPoints.text: `useActionState` is a new hook for ordering Actions and reading their state and pending status.
keyPoints.quote: `useActionState`: is a new hook to order Actions inside of a Transition

keyPoints.text: Form Actions and `useFormStatus` manage form submission, and forms reset automatically after a successful action.
keyPoints.quote: `<form> action` prop: Form Actions allow you to manage forms automatically and integrate with `useFormStatus`.

keyPoints.text: Refs can be passed as props, so `forwardRef` is no longer needed.
keyPoints.quote: `ref` as a prop: Refs can now be used as props, removing the need for `forwardRef`.

keyPoints.text: Upgrading to `18.3.1` first shows warnings for deprecated APIs and changes needed for React 19.
keyPoints.quote: We recommend upgrading to React 18.3.1 first to help identify any issues before upgrading to React 19.

breakingChanges.change: The new JSX transform is now required.
breakingChanges.migration: Enable the new JSX transform in your build configuration.
breakingChanges.quote: New JSX Transform is now required

breakingChanges.change: `propTypes` are silently ignored.
breakingChanges.migration: Migrate to TypeScript or another type-checking solution.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: `propTypes`: Using `propTypes` will now be silently ignored.

breakingChanges.change: `defaultProps` is removed for function components, while class components still support it.
breakingChanges.migration: Use ES6 default parameters in function components.

breakingChanges.change: String refs are removed.
breakingChanges.migration: Migrate string refs to ref callbacks.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: string refs: Any usage of string refs need to be migrated to ref callbacks.

breakingChanges.change: Legacy Context (`contextTypes` and `getChildContext`) is removed.
breakingChanges.migration: Migrate class components to the `contextType` API.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: `contextTypes` and `getChildContext`: Legacy Context for class components has been removed in favor of the `contextType` API.

breakingChanges.change: `React.createFactory` is removed.
breakingChanges.migration: Migrate createFactory usage to JSX components.

breakingChanges.change: Uncaught render errors are no longer re-thrown and are reported to `window.reportError`.
breakingChanges.migration: Use the `onUncaughtError` and `onCaughtError` options of `createRoot` and `hydrateRoot` to customize error handling.

breakingChanges.change: `ReactDOM.render`, `ReactDOM.hydrate` and `unmountComponentAtNode` are removed.
breakingChanges.migration: Use `ReactDOM.createRoot` or `ReactDOM.hydrateRoot`, and call `root.unmount()` instead of `unmountComponentAtNode`.

breakingChanges.change: `ReactDOM.findDOMNode` is removed.
breakingChanges.migration: Replace `findDOMNode` with DOM refs.

breakingChanges.change: `react-dom/test-utils` is removed, and `act` moves to `react`.
breakingChanges.migration: Import `act` from `react` instead of `react-dom/test-utils`.

breakingChanges.change: The global `JSX` namespace is removed from TypeScript.
breakingChanges.migration: Import `JSX` from `react` where you need it.

breakingChanges.change: UMD builds are removed.
breakingChanges.migration: Load React from an ESM-based CDN such as esm.sh instead of a script tag with a UMD build.

unexpected.change: The global `JSX` namespace is removed from TypeScript.

content.title: React 19.2 adds `<Activity>`, `useEffectEvent` and resume APIs; reconciler container parameter order changed.

keyPoints.text: `<Activity>` is a new API that hides and restores the UI and internal state of its children.
keyPoints.quote: A new API to hide and restore the UI and internal state of its children.

keyPoints.text: `useEffectEvent` extracts non-reactive logic out of Effects into Effect Events.
New resume APIs support partial pre-rendering with both Web Streams and Node Streams.
keyPoints.quote: Added resume APIs for partial pre-rendering with Web Streams:

keyPoints.text: React DOM now batches Suspense boundary reveals, matching client side rendering.
keyPoints.quote: React DOM now batches suspense boundary reveals, matching the behavior of client side rendering.

keyPoints.text: `cacheSignal` (for RSCs) tells you when the `cache()` lifetime is over.

breakingChanges.change: The parameter order of `createContainer` and `createHydrationContainer` was adjusted after the `on*` handlers.
breakingChanges.migration: The notes give no migration steps, so check any direct calls to these functions in custom renderers and update them to the new parameter order.
breakingChanges.quote: had their parameter order adjusted after `on*` handlers to account for upcoming experimental APIs

unexpected.change: The parameter order of `createContainer` and `createHydrationContainer` was adjusted after the `on*` handlers.

keyPoints.text: Fixes missing `FormData` entries in Server Actions, a regression introduced in 19.2.6.
keyPoints.quote: Fixed missing `FormData` entries in Server Actions which regressed in 19.2.6

keyPoints.text: The only listed change is under React Server Components.

keyPoints.text: `new-cap` only exempts built-ins that reference the global.
keyPoints.quote: feat: only exempt `new-cap` built-ins that reference the global

keyPoints.text: `object-shorthand` now handles quoted properties for `ignoreConstructors`.
keyPoints.quote: feat: object-shorthand handle quoted properties for `ignoreConstructors`

keyPoints.quote: fix: don't report `__proto__` properties in `object-shorthand`

keyPoints.quote: docs: note that --cache can serve stale results for cross-file rules

content.title: Adds new scrollbar, zoom, tab and container-size utilities, plus more flexible @variant and many fixes.

keyPoints.text: Adds `@container-size`, `scrollbar-*`, `scrollbar-gutter-*`, `zoom-*` and `tab-*` utilities.
keyPoints.quote: Add `@container-size` utility

keyPoints.text: `@variant` now accepts stacked variants like `hover:focus` and compound variants like `hover, focus`.
keyPoints.quote: Allow using `@variant` with compound variants (e.g. `@variant hover, focus { … }`)

keyPoints.text: `--default(…)` is supported in `--value(…)` and `--modifier(…)` for functional `@utility` definitions.
keyPoints.quote: Support `--default(…)` in `--value(…)` and `--modifier(…)` for functional `@utility` definitions

keyPoints.text: Vite integration fixes relative `@import` and `@plugin` path resolution and processing of files containing `@variant`.
keyPoints.quote: Fix relative `@import` and `@plugin` paths resolving from the wrong directory when using `@tailwindcss/vite`

keyPoints.text: Canonicalization fixes cover arbitrary values, units, operator whitespace and `:has()` variants.

content.title: Tailwind CSS 4.2.4 is a small patch fixing Vite alias imports, with no breaking changes listed.

keyPoints.text: The only listed change is a fix so `@import` and `@plugin` still resolve Vite aliases in `@tailwindcss/vite`.
keyPoints.quote: Ensure imports in `@import` and `@plugin` still resolve correctly when using Vite aliases in `@tailwindcss/vite`

keyPoints.text: The notes list no new features and no other fixes.
The notes describe no breaking changes or required code or configuration changes.

content.title: Zod 4.6 adds z.validate() and z.iban(), but several outputs and error behaviors change, so check upgrades.

keyPoints.text: `.validate()` returns a boolean without building a ZodError, up to 35x faster than `.safeParse().success` on compiled schemas.
keyPoints.quote: without constructing a `ZodError`, which makes rejection cheap.

keyPoints.text: `z.properties()` and `.properties()` on `z.instanceof()` validate properties in place, so class instances like Response keep their prototype.
keyPoints.quote: Unlike `z.object()` it validates *in-place*, so it plays nice with class instances.

keyPoints.text: `z.fromJSONSchema()` now enforces six keywords it used to ignore, including `uniqueItems` and `contains`.
keyPoints.quote: Six additional JSON Schema keywords are now supported in `z.fromJSONSchema()`.

keyPoints.text: `z.iban()` validates IBAN strings with an ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 checksum.
keyPoints.quote: A new string format: an IBAN in electronic format, with a valid ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 checksum.

keyPoints.text: `z.withParser()` installs a parser generated elsewhere, for environments where `new Function` is blocked.
keyPoints.quote: `z.compile()` builds its parser with `new Function`, which a strict Content Security Policy blocks.

breakingChanges.change: Error maps run when `result.error` is first read, not at parse time, so changing `z.config()` between the parse and the read applies the newer configuration.
breakingChanges.migration: Read `result.error` before changing `z.config()` if you need the configuration from parse time. An error map with a side effect does not run if nothing reads the error.
breakingChanges.quote: Code that swaps z.config() between the parse and the read gets the newer configuration.

breakingChanges.change: `z.emoji()` now rejects strings made only of emoji components, such as `123`, `#`, `*` or a lone joiner or skin tone modifier.
breakingChanges.migration: Check any stored or accepted input that was valid only as an emoji component, such as `123`, and treat it as invalid.
breakingChanges.quote: The pattern now requires at least one pictograph, regional indicator, or keycap.

breakingChanges.change: `.options` on a numeric TypeScript enum no longer includes the reverse-mapping keys, so it lists only the enum values.
breakingChanges.migration: Stop relying on reverse-mapping keys in `z.enum(...).options`. A three-member numeric enum now lists `[0, 1, 2]`.
breakingChanges.quote: so a three-member enum listed six values and three of them failed to parse.

breakingChanges.change: `z.base64()` and `z.base64url()` check length and padding in code, and composing `z.base64()` into a template literal no longer checks length. The exported `z.regexes.base64url` is now length-aware.
breakingChanges.migration: If you compose base64 into a template literal or use `z.regexes.base64url`, add your own length check where you need one. `z.toJSONSchema()` output is unchanged.
breakingChanges.quote: Composing `z.base64()` into a template literal now checks the alphabet but not the length, which is how `z.creditCard()` already behaves there.

breakingChanges.change: The email pattern no longer has lookaheads or capture groups, so the pattern string in `z.regexes.email`, `issue.pattern` and `z.toJSONSchema()` output changes.
breakingChanges.migration: Check any code that matches on the email pattern string, `issue.pattern`, or capture groups from `z.regexes.email`, and update it to the new pattern.
breakingChanges.quote: The pattern string is user-visible, and every copy of it changes

breakingChanges.change: `z.toJSONSchema()` folds chained checks together, so the emitted bounds are tighter and no longer depend on chain order.
breakingChanges.migration: Regenerate your JSON Schema output and review the bounds, since the emitted minimum, maximum and multipleOf values can differ from 4.5.
breakingChanges.quote: The converter folds the checks as a conjunction now.

breakingChanges.change: Schema members such as `.format`, `.minLength` and `.maxLength` are no longer own properties until read, so `Object.keys` and `Object.assign` output differs, and order-dependent chains can report a different value.
breakingChanges.migration: Read these members directly rather than using `Object.keys` or `Object.assign` to find them, and recheck any code that relied on a chain's earlier value.
breakingChanges.quote: Each one is a prototype getter that becomes an own property on first read.

inventedQuotes: Code that swaps z.config() between the parse and the read gets the newer configuration.

content.title: Prisma 7.10.0 adds `@prisma/prisma7` to run Prisma 7 beside Prisma 8 and hardens Studio's local server.

keyPoints.text: Adds `@prisma/prisma7` so a matching Prisma 7 CLI and configuration can run beside Prisma 8 in one project.
keyPoints.quote: This release introduces `@prisma/prisma7`, a compatibility package that lets you retain a matching Prisma 7 CLI and configuration while installing Prisma 8 in the same project.

keyPoints.text: Prisma Studio's local server now binds to `127.0.0.1` and rejects browser requests from other origins.
keyPoints.quote: Binds explicitly to `127.0.0.1` instead of all network interfaces.

keyPoints.text: Parameter-chunked statements now run atomically in a transaction and roll back if a later chunk fails.
keyPoints.quote: Parameter-chunked statements are now executed atomically in a transaction and rolled back if a later chunk fails.

keyPoints.text: Prisma Postgres Serverless now prefers the named constraint for `P2002` errors, falling back to parsed field names.
`prisma generate` can offer to install Prisma's agent skills, as an opt-in prompt that is skipped in CI.
